warnings: King-post truss T1: tie (ขื่อ) between the two posts on rows A and B (3.00), centre post up to the ridge 0.90 above the tie, rafters continuing 1.20 past each post to the eave (chain 1.20 / 3.00 / 1.20 = A''' .. B''), eave tip 0.30 below the tie. Every member printed LG -100x50x2.3 mm (เหล็กกล่อง) — designation LG kept as printed.

Purlins here are แปเหล็ก [-75x45x15x2.3 mm @1.00 m; the S-02 plan instead names คร่าวเหล็กฉาก L-40x40x2.3 @0.80-0.90 — for the member spec this detail sheet wins (precedence: detail over plan); the plan reading is kept on S-02 and flagged there.
Roofing (กระเบื้องลอนคู่ หนา 5 มม.), ridge / hip capping and the สลักเกลียว ง.งู / ป.ปลา hooks are non-structural accessories — transcribed in note only.
